name: SpaceX Falcon 9 Block 5 (reusable first stage, droneship recovery)

cd.assumption: not published; generic slender-launcher drag coefficient (same default used for Electron)

propellant_kg.derived: Block 5 LOX 287,400 kg + RP-1 123,500 kg tank capacities (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9_Block_5#Specifications, citing Espace & Exploration No.39)

thrust_sl_N.src: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9#Specifications (7,607 kN SL); SpaceX Falcon User's Guide https://www.spacex.com/media/falcon-users-guide-2021-09.pdf

max_burn_s.src: SpaceX mission timeline MECO T+00:02:26 (https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16). Stage-1 mdot = 410.9 t / 162 s (published burn time; thrust scaled to keep Isp, ~0.94x, standing in for the unpublished Max-Q throttle-down); cutoff at 146 s leaves ~41 t (~10%) on board = DERIVED stand-in for droneship landing propellant

propellant_kg.derived: Block 5 LOX 75,200 kg + RP-1 32,300 kg tank capacities (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9_Block_5#Specifications)

coast_before_s.derived: SpaceX timeline MECO T+2:26 -> SES-1 T+2:36 (https://www.spacex.com/launches/sl-15-16)

diameter_m.src: fairing diameter 5.2 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falcon_9#Payload_fairing); used as drag reference diameter for whole stack

vertical_rise_until_vrel_mps.assumption: pitch-over once Earth-relative speed reaches 60 m/s; not published (same rule as LM-6A/8A configs)

header_notes: Falcon 9 Block 5 masses from Wikipedia 'Falcon 9 Block 5' spec table; thrust/Isp from Wikipedia 'Falcon 9' spec table (citing SpaceX); event times from SpaceX's sl-15-16 timeline.
Throttle profile not published: stage 1 uses the average mdot implied by propellant/162 s burn time and cuts off at the published MECO; the unburned ~41 t stands in for landing propellant.
